scope: Startup registration and unchanged-data reuse verification; no cluster startup-time guarantee

regression.command: .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_fann_startup_cache tests.test_fann_formal tests.test_fann_speed tests.test_fann_adapters tests.test_fann_bounded_graphs

coverage: Warm registration hit does not read sample contents
Parallel normalization is bitwise equal to serial normalization in original sample order
Four processes build only one registration
Sample or shared mesh changes invalidate registration, including preserved mtime with changed ctime
Test labels do not enter training normalization
Registered loading skips repeated content checks and rejects concurrent input replacement
Old checkpoint resume and explicit unchanged-data import remain compatible
Changed registered data never reuse old checkpoint statistics

real_full_case_read_probe.scope: Local real full-case load timings only; not shared-filesystem startup or epoch speed prediction

limitations: Metadata reuse assumes prepared files remain unchanged; this is not a fresh content audit
Explicit import from an old checkpoint relies on user assertion that data remained unchanged since that checkpoint
Workers and bandwidth benefit have not been measured on the X203 shared filesystem
Model initialization and first graph/neighbor cache construction remain separate startup costs
